title: Alaska Air Guardsmen rescue rock climber at Hatcher's Pass
description: Six pararescuemen from the 212th Rescue Squadron boarded an HH-60G Pave Hawk helicopter from the 210th Rescue Squadron to respond to the injured hiker who was isolated on a grassy ledge at Hatcher's pass on July 14, 2020. The hiker was transported to Providence Alaska Medical Center and released to medical personnel there. For this mission, the 210th and 212th rescue squadrons, and the AKRCC were awarded one save. (Courtesy video by Jake Sloan)
